chunks: I wrote to Abu Muhammad al-Hasan al-'Askari عليه السلام: Is it permissible to place two deceased persons on one bier in a situation of necessity and scarcity of people? And if the two deceased are a man and a woman, may they be carried on one bier and the funeral prayer be performed over them?
So he عليه السلام wrote in reply: “A man is not to be carried with a woman on one bier.”

key_terms.أَيَجُوزُ: Is it permissible; a juridical inquiry about legal validity
key_terms.الْمَيِّتَيْنِ: The two deceased persons being discussed in the ruling
key_terms.جَنَازَةٍ وَاحِدَةٍ: One bier or funeral conveyance for the dead
key_terms.سَرِيرٍ وَاحِدٍ: A single bier or platform on which the deceased are carried
key_terms.قِلَّةِ النَّاسِ: A shortage of people available to assist
key_terms.مَوْضِعِ الْحَاجَةِ: A circumstance of necessity or pressing need

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible in Shia fiqh to carry a deceased man and woman together on one bier?
ai.summary: This hadith records a legal question addressed to Imam al-Hasan al-'Askari عليه السلام concerning carrying two deceased persons on a single bier in cases of need. The Imam عليه السلام ruled specifically that a man and a woman must not be carried together on one bier, indicating a funerary legal distinction in such circumstances.
